thread:
emma: quick readout from vela9b quant experiments. ran int4 and int6 variants against int8 baseline for our summarization + chat mix. headline: int4 ~= 45% token cost reduction, int6 ~= 28% reduction. quality: short/chat parity, long summaries see degradation (int4 ~5% recall drop, int6 ~2.2%).
jordi: can you drop the slice breakdown?
emma: slices: chat-short (60% traffic, <=50 tokens), multi-turn (30%, ~200 tokens), long-summaries (10%, >700 tokens). sims used 60/30/10.
kai: latency/throughput numbers?
emma: p50 short: int4 55ms / int6 61ms / int8 72ms. p95 short: int4 120ms / int6 131ms / int8 145ms. tokens/s: int4 ~1.3x vs int8. KV memory reduced ~22% on int4.
mila: any stability issues during soak?
emma: 48h soak, one soft GC pause on int4 under heavy batching (fixed by lowering batch for >1024 tokens). no crashes.
jordi: product: long-summary recall drop is concerning for GTN. how concentrated is the impact?
emma: concentrated in OCR-heavy and multi-doc inputs (~70% of the long-summary errors). high-quality prompts (top-decile) saw <1.5% drop.
kai: sounds like hybrid routing candidate. propose simple token-based split + confidence fallback.
jordi: propose gating: recall_top5 delta <= 1.0% for GTN summary slice, p95 latency increase <= 10ms, net cost change per 1M tokens <= -20% (target).
emma: sample routing config below
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"max_tokens": 64, "model": "vela9b-int4"},
    {"min_tokens": 65, "max_tokens": 400, "model": "vela9b-int6"},
    {"min_tokens": 401, "model": "vela9b-int8"}
  ],
  "confidence_fallback": {"threshold": 0.4, "fallback_model": "aurora14b-int8"},
  "canary": {"pct": 5, "duration_hours": 48, "gates": ["recall_top5","p95_latency"]}
}
```
mila: ops: need trace-id injection + eval sink for sampled long-summary requests. also create billing cap for aurora fallback.
ops-bot: scheduled canary window tentative -> 2025-10-02T08:00Z, canary 5% for 48h. health endpoints: /health/serving, /metrics/eval-sink. billing cap: aurora fallback 30% of pilot budget.
jordi: decision: run constrained canary. emma owns eval dashboard and dataset tagging, kai owns routing rule PR, mila owns deploy automation and caps.
emma: will add a one-pager with slice-level projections and a small notebook with example failure cases. closing thread.
